description: A bearded man in black 17th-century clothing with a white falling collar kneels beside a stone basin of water in a dim brick room, one hand raised. Around him a small group sits and kneels: a man on the left with hands clasped, two women in white coifs and dark dresses on the right, and more figures in the background by a doorway. A hearth with a hanging cauldron is at the left. The style is an oil painting, with no visible text, frame or border.
